system.description:
Halflings can draw glyphs on a space. Once an enemy creature enters a space with a glyph drawn on it, the glyph's effect will activate. Choose any of the following Glyphs to use when doing so. Glyphs have an Evasion Value of 10. Glyphs are only visible to any creature with 4 or more Arcana.

  • Lightning: Every creature on and within 1 space of this Glyph are shocked with lightning which deals damage equal to [Soul + 3] and become Shocked.
  • Earth: Every creature on and within 1 space of this Glyph are dropped into a pit 3 spaces deep. The walls of this pit are steep and are Climbing Terrain.
  • Poison: Every creature on and within 1 space of this Glyph are afflicted by a Draining poison that lasts until removed or the end of an Engagement.
  • Barrier: Every creature on and within 1 space of this Glyph are trapped in to their current space by a wall of magyk. The barrier created by this glyph has 10 Health. Until the barrier is down the trapped creature(s) can not make attacks past it, but they can also not be targeted by attacks.
